route.name: Bagdogra Airport -> Siliguri (Hill Cart Road / Burdwan Road junction area)

starts.name: Bagdogra Airport
starts.desc: Flat tarmac and NH27 into Siliguri (11 km).

starts.name: Siliguri (Hill Cart Road)
starts.desc: Town traffic, then north towards Sukna.

starts.name: Sukna
starts.desc: Foothills: Hill Cart Road climbs towards Tindharia.

starts.name: Tindharia
starts.desc: Mountain hairpins — drive down to Sukna.
